title: Start your project: request a quote | Mr Wallcover
description: Tell us the building, the material and the date. Dorin Burcus reads every enquiry; quotations follow a site survey or drawings. Or email info@mrwallcover.com.
heading: Start your project.
lede: A short note is enough: the building, the material if you know it, and the date you have in mind. Tell us whether you would like a reply by email or by phone. Photographs, drawings and PDFs help, and are optional.
photoNote: Phone photographs, labels and drawings help. You can send them with the note or by email.
mailtoStatus: Your email application should open with this enquiry. If it does not, write to us at the address below.
direct: Or go direct. The phone is answered by Dorin Burcus himself; the number is shown on request.
directNoPhone: Or write directly. Email is read by Dorin Burcus.
spamNote: Press send and your note goes straight through.

next._note: The 'What happens next' list on /contact/ (src/pages/contact.astro). Each step restates copy the site already publishes, named in 'source'. No reply window, survey lead time or scope turnaround: Dorin has stated none. Add times here only once he does. The 'booking' step prints only when BOOKING_URL is set.
